dedupe_keys.name: haiti health facilities paho who about 730 operating institutions with category public or private status institution code and coordinates

description: This data set lists Haiti's operating health facilities with their locations, from the Pan American Health Organization, WHO's regional office for the Americas. It is published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange by the UN humanitarian office in Haiti. Each of about 730 institutions has its department, commune and communal section with codes, name, category (such as hospital, health centre or dispensary), public or private status, institution code and coordinates. Coverage is national, with reference dates from 2019 to 2023. The table and a shapefile are free and available to download under CC BY. Caveats: bed numbers and services are not given, several facilities share rounded coordinates, and the list has not been updated since 2023 despite changes in access due to insecurity. Simulation uses: mapping hospitals against hurricane, earthquake and flood hazards, planning emergency medical response after disasters, and modelling travel time to care. Related records: Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) gives open facility points worldwide, and the Caribbean smart hospitals initiative (case_study-caribbean-smart-hospitals) concerns hurricane resilience of hospitals in the region.
